_comment: THE scale control (docs/FILTERS.md). BDH holds 150M+ rows; every object needs a filter (or an explicit fullScanAllowed entry / ALLOW_FULL_SCAN=true) or the crawl REFUSES it. 'partition' predicates match Hive partition KEYS (dt=..., region=...) and prune whole directories with zero I/O; date operators apply to dt. 'anyOf' is an OR of {allOf:[...]} AND-groups evaluated per row while streaming ('allOf' at the top level is shorthand for one group). Operators: equals, notEquals, in, notIn, prefix, contains, gte, lte, between, withinLastDays, after, before, isNull, isNotNull. Field lookup is case-insensitive. Malformed filters are startup errors, never ignored.

Contact.notes: Active-mailbox contacts from the last ~15 months of partitions.

Opportunity.notes: All open pipeline plus closed-lost from the last 6 months.
